description: Fetch incidents from the Microsoft Defender XDR API (OData /api/incidents)
name: Fetch incidents from Microsoft Defender XDR

base_url.description: Base URL of the Defender XDR API hosting /api/incidents (e.g. 'https://api-eu.security.microsoft.com'). If empty, the module-level base_url is used.

start_time.description: The number of hours from which incidents should be queried on the first run.

intake_key.description: Intake key to use when sending events
